payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort vertices by energy descending; remove in that order, paying sum of remaining neighbor energies. Achieves total cost = sum_{edges} min(v_u, v_v).
payload.rationale: The code sorts indices by vertex values in descending order, then removes vertices, adding neighbor values only if neighbor not removed. This greedy order minimizes total cost by ensuring each edge contributes min(v_u,v_v).
